name: Vincent Vollachia
japaneseName: ヴィンセント・ヴォラキア
description: Vincent Vollachia, also known under his alias Abel, is the seventy-seventh Emperor of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the half-brother of Priscilla Barielle. Driven into hiding following a coup d'état designed to avert the prophesied Great Disaster, he forged an alliance with Natsuki Subaru to reclaim the capital and lead the Empire across Arc 7 and Arc 8.
